user.title: Set up Leasing KM Calculator
user.description: Enter your leasing contract details. The odometer entity must already exist in Home Assistant.

data_description.start_date: First day of the leasing contract.
data_description.km_gesamt: Total kilometres included in the contract.
data_description.km_entity: A sensor or input_number that holds the current odometer reading in km.
data_description.kosten_aktiv: When enabled, projected costs and refunds are calculated at contract end.
data_description.mehrkilometer_cent: Nachbelastungssatz Mehr-km Service in ct/km incl. all surcharges (e.g. 9 = 0.09 €/km). Only used when cost calculation is enabled.
data_description.minderkilometer_cent: Erstattungssatz Minder-km Service in ct/km (e.g. 5 = 0.05 €/km). Set to 0 if your contract offers no refund. Only used when cost calculation is enabled.
data_description.toleranz_mehr_km: Tolerance band for extra kilometres. Within this range no charge applies. Set to 0 to disable. Once exceeded, ALL extra kilometres are charged.
data_description.toleranz_minder_km: Tolerance band for under-kilometres. Within this range no refund applies. Set to 0 to disable. Refund starts above this threshold.
data_description.minder_grenze_km: Maximum number of under-kilometres eligible for refund (excluding tolerance). E.g. 10000 means refund applies for km 1–10000 above the tolerance threshold. Set to 0 for unlimited.

error.entity_unavailable: The selected odometer entity is currently unavailable.
error.invalid_value: The odometer entity does not report a valid numeric value.

abort.already_configured: This leasing contract is already configured.
